Police constable martyred, two injured in firing at Lakki Marwat judicial complex

Nasruminallah October 31, 2026

A police constable was martyred and two other people were injured when unidentified gunmen opened fire outside the courtroom of the judicial complex in Lakki Marwat on Saturday.

District Headquarters (DHQ) Hospital spokesperson Jalal Khan said Constable Karamatullah was killed on the spot, while the injured were shifted to the hospital for treatment.
